v2_statement: The quoted CSXA 99.87 % of 3,720 and BUU-LSPINE 98.04 % of 2,698 were computed on the allspine_v2 bank, whose validation split leaks NHANES II and CTSpinoPelvic1K patients into training (docs/RESUME_2026-09-22_PM.md). CSXA and BUU films are keyed by their own corpus ids (one film = one CSXA person; one 4-digit BUU case = one person), so a CSXA or BUU validation film cannot leak through the NHANES/CTSP defect; that is the sense in which the per-source figures are unaffected. They cannot be re-scored: the v2 bank was deleted on 2026-09-20 and head_mixed_length.py saved no per-vertebra prediction. The numbers below are the SAME protocol on the clean v8 bank, which is the bank the manuscript must quote; v8's known leak is VerSe (CT renders), which touches no film source.
